blockingIssues: P1 — Make the frozen neutral-handoff validator conform to its published topology contract. It currently accepts any finite non-fixed joint axis rather than a finite unit axis, and it does not verify that each joint parent/child edge agrees with the child frame's declared parentFrameId. Enforce a non-zero unit-vector tolerance and frame/joint edge consistency, then add negative conformance cases proving that zero/non-unit axes and contradictory trees are rejected.

P1 — Make COMMON-EVIDENCE-COVERAGE validate the complete frozen evidence-record contract rather than only identifiers and partial set membership. Enforce every required field in common-evaluation-method.json for motion, collision, and accuracy; enforce uniqueness before every exact-set comparison (including segmentIds, payloadCaseIds, geometryReferenceIds, and poseIds); and define and verify inputDigest against a canonical, published input-byte set instead of accepting any SHA-256-shaped string. Add negative conformance cases for omitted result fields, duplicate/substituted coverage IDs, and an unbound digest.
